lead_raw_text:
The structure of Rb2PrAgI6 crystallizes in the cubic space group Fm-3m (No. 225), with a 40-atom unit cell (Rb8 Pr4 Ag4 I24) and four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Ag and Pr each in octahedral environments of six I neighbors, while Rb exhibits a close-packed-like local arrangement with twelve I neighbors; the I sites coordinate to one Ag and one Pr. Corner-sharing between Ag and Pr octahedra and face-sharing involving Rb polyhedra are observed, forming a three-dimensional connected network.
